method.visualInspection: V2, v1, and the actual ToDoo style screenshot were each viewed using view_image in the independent child context. Original baseline was inspected in the preceding independent v1 review. No image embedded in main conversation.
method.comparison: Checked v2 actual visible content against v1, the original-baseline findings, existing source owner controls, and ToDoo style authority. Judged readability, hierarchy, density, palette, controls and state without treating generated geometry as pixel-accurate CSS.

followups.finding: Primary rail and context sidebar look roomier than the compact ToDoo reference and approximate prompt proportions.
followups.correction: Use the agreed compact shared rail/sidebar/header tokens when the full design set is consolidated, preserving the existing resizable sidebar and flexible main canvas. Do not treat raster pixel widths as a CSS contract or a functional blocker.

followups.finding: The generated blue buttons and light surfaces carry subtle gradients/texture beyond the flatter ToDoo reference.
followups.correction: Use the reference's flat color surfaces and established border/button tokens in the consolidated specification; do not reproduce generated raster texture in CSS.

followups.finding: V2 uses brighter saturated blue actions/brand and darker nearly black rail/directory icons than the muted cobalt/slate treatment in the actual ToDoo style authority.
followups.correction: Use the actual ToDoo shared blue, neutral text, muted icon and selection tokens across modules. Preserve readable contrast without taking v2 electric blue or its dark icon palette as new design authority.

comparison.selectionReason: V1 retains the same complete source controls and readable labels, while its more restrained cobalt and slate-gray line icons are closer to the actual ToDoo reference. V2 strengthens contrast but shifts blue saturation and icon tone away from that reference.
comparison.v2Improvements: Stronger control/label contrast, clearer sidebar boundaries and prominent resize grip.
comparison.v2Limitations: No meaningful visual compaction versus v1 is apparent; subtle surface shading remains. Its stronger blue/black palette is less consistent with the actual ToDoo reference.
comparison.densityJudgment: Both concepts show the correct rail/context/main hierarchy and uncluttered owner empty state. Their proportions are illustrative; source sidebar remains resizable. Agree shared control heights, spacing, typography and default widths in the consolidated CSS specification.

scopeLimits: WS-002 mobile drawer and WS-098 compact more-navigation are context only; this desktop image does not validate their layouts, focus or breakpoints.
Closed account/create menus and folder expansion contents are not visible; their retained source behavior must be preserved in implementation.
Image cannot verify keyboard/touch behavior, accessible names, action guards, actual API permissions, hit targets, responsive layout or resizer operation.
